in_marathi.name: प्रवीण
in_marathi.long_meaning: प्रवीण हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘प्रव’, meaning ‘before’. The suffix ‘ीण’ denotes the idea of possession or ownership. Thus, the name Pravīṇ translates to ‘One who possesses before others’. In Hindu mythology, Lord Rama, an embodiment of dharma, is also known by the name Pravīṇ. The name is believed to bestow the qualities of courage, strength, and wisdom.
